biotools.summary: OneFlowTraX is an open-source software for super-resolution microscopy (SRM) data analysis, providing an automated all-in-one solution for single-molecule localization, tracking, and clustering.  It simplifies data management following FAIR principles and allows analysis of millions of molecules in a few minutes.
